d: Room. Notary Pistofolo writing, Don Calloandro dressing coldly ahead a throne, Don Luigino courting woman Eugenia, and Amaranta, and Servitors serving.
Don Calloandro, and Notaro Pistofolo, then Rachelina.
The House of the Notaro, of which the house of the Baroness, at the end of the hut, and the mill, can be seen on one side. Notary Pistofolo with his young people in the curia, then Don Rospolone.
Notaro, then Calloandro, and Don Rospolone.
Countryside with mill and rustic houses. Rachelina from the mill, then Notaro, and Calloandro.
Donna Eugenia, Don Luigino, Rospolone, the Servants and the two who peep from the windows of the hut, Rachelina coming back. Amaranta.
Rustic room with two side roomsRachelina working, and a little after Calloandro.
Dettali and Calloandro lightly dressed as a gardener, and Notar Pistofolo from Molinaro ambi with the aforementioned introments.
Wood with rocks practicable. Rachelina then Rospolone, then the Notaro all fleeing on different roads; last Calloandro.
Rospolone as a doctor followed by two other fake Medici, who come out seriously, at Rospolone's nod go to stand in the middle of the Notaro and sayings.
Eugenia, and sayings; then Amaranta, then Luigino from various streets, and finally Calloandro, the Notaro, and Rachelina from one after the other.
